mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_events(user_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, idempotency_key, payload) VALUES (CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{eventType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{aggregateType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{aggregateId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{idempotencyKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{payload, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id::text AS user_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, idempotency_key, payload::text AS payload_json, failure_count, last_error, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM created_at) AS created_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM published_at) AS published_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM dead_lettered_at) AS dead_lettered_at FROM outbox_events WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND published_at IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, user_id::text AS user_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, idempotency_key, payload::text AS payload_json, failure_count, last_error, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM created_at) AS created_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM published_at) AS published_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM dead_lettered_at) AS dead_lettered_at FROM outbox_events WHERE published_at IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_events SET published_at = COALESCE(published_at, now()) WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND id = #{eventId} AND published_at IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL

UPDATE outbox_events SET failure_count = failure_count + 1, last_error = LEFT(#{error, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1000), dead_lettered_at = CASE WHEN #{deadLetter} THEN now() ELSE dead_lettered_at END WHERE id = #{eventId} AND published_at IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL
